scope: source-only; no live queue or runtime mutation

requirements.contract: Root, middle, tail, multiple and merged closures do not remain active; lifecycle-only cleanup precedes native gates and preserves source and unrelated labels.

Complete current provider facts authorize exact missing-suffix reformation after a retained merged prefix without fabricating an earlier checkpoint; raw history survives and repeated complete observations are no-ops.
Changed Stack/history/head/base/merge state, unknown/interleaved history, intersecting mappings and truncated inventory never authorize automatic reformation or force rebase.
Partial label progress and lost provider responses preserve receipts and never authorize replaying a completed transition.
The existing explicitly scoped cleanup keeps its no-admission/no-source-write boundary and fresh race guards.

delivery: Focused hermetic tests answer the changed-path uncertainties; required hosted CI owns final broad validation. Publication is not installation or live acceptance.
